## Ko-fi Reviews: Customer Feedback

Ko-fi's community feedback is mixed, and negative complaints are not uncommon, while their score on Trustpilot is 4.6/5. While many users enjoy the simplicity, others highlight real problems:

### 1. Customer Support Complaints

Several creators report Ko-fi's customer support is slow or unhelpful. For example, Yoyo on Trustpilot wrote that Ko-fi took down their account “for no reason” and then ignored all requests to restore it. They said support responses were absurdly useless and felt totally abandoned.

Trustpilot review reporting Ko-fi account takedown and unhelpful support.

 Confusing fees: Many features still charge 5%, and “0% fees” can be misleading.

 Weak marketing tools: Lacks email campaigns, automation, and CRM features.

 Very basic design: Good for simple pages, but not a full website or advanced brand presence.

results.title: Is Ko-fi A Scam Or Safe For Creators In 2026?
results.content:
Ko-fi has been operating since 2012, has paid out over $200 million to creators, and holds a 4.6-star Trustpilot rating from over 700 reviews – a score that places it comfortably ahead of every major competing platform in the creator support space.

The complaints that exist are concentrated in a specific, identifiable area: automated content moderation that occasionally acts faster than human review can catch up with. That is a real problem worth knowing about. It is not a scam.

Quick verdict [...] The scam question comes up for a few reasons. A vocal minority of negative reviews on Trustpilot describe account bans that felt sudden and unexplained. Some creators who produce content that edges toward Ko-fi’s policy limits have found their pages taken down after linking to external profiles.

And the general wariness people have developed about creator platforms – after years of high-profile problems with Patreon, OnlyFans policy changes, and Buy Me a Coffee payout freezes – means any negative review gets amplified. Looking at the actual pattern of complaints puts those reviews in context.

Creator Platform · Quick facts

Ko-fi – At a glance

Founded2012 (Ko-fi Labs Ltd incorporated 2017)

HeadquartersCambridge, United Kingdom

Trustpilot rating4.6 / 5 – “Excellent” (700+ reviews) [...] Ko-fi compares very favorably to its main competitors on Trustpilot in 2026. Ko-fi holds 4.6 out of 5 stars from over 700 reviews, rated "Excellent." Patreon holds 1.2 out of 5 from nearly 900 reviews, with chronic complaints about withheld payouts, arbitrary account restrictions, and poor support. Buy Me a Coffee holds 3.5 out of 5 from over 1,400 reviews, with a documented pattern of accounts being suspended at withdrawal time with balances refunded to supporters rather than creators. Ko-fi is not just better than its competitors by a small margin – it is in a different category of creator trust.
